none: PAS HESH-E2D8B2: Contemporary copy of a radiate of Claudius II (268-270AD).
contea di ritrovamento: County of Herefordshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy or base silver contemporary copy of a radiate (or antoninianus) of Claudius II (268-270AD). The obverse depicts a radiate crowned head facing right. The obverse inscription reads: [...]DIVS PF [...]. The reverse depicts a female figure standing left with cornucopiae in right hand and ? in left. The figure is fairly crude but also very worn. The reverse inscription is illegible. There is a small area of silver plate on the obverse which suggests that the coin was a contemporary copy (or forgery) designed to decieve. References. Reece, R and James, S 1986 Identifying Roman Coins Seaby
